company.name: Harborline
company.summary: Fictional B2B SaaS company, about 120 people, preparing for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.

risks.title: Public marketing site
risks.statement: The marketing site bucket can be read by anyone on the internet.
risks.treatmentPlan: Turn on Block Public Access and confirm the next collection.

risks.title: Missing MFA
risks.statement: Two workforce accounts can sign in with a password alone.
risks.treatmentPlan: Require a second factor before the account is marked active.

risks.title: Leaver still has access
risks.statement: An offboarded person still has a GitHub account.
risks.treatmentPlan: Remove the GitHub account and record it in the access review.

risks.title: Unprotected branch
risks.statement: The experiments repository can be changed without a second reviewer.

risks.title: Vendor concentration
risks.statement: Source hosting and identity both sit with one or two suppliers.
risks.treatmentPlan: Keep the suppliers' reports and a named exit path.

risks.title: Backup restore untested
risks.statement: The last restore drill is older than the policy allows.
risks.treatmentPlan: Run a restore of the customer-files bucket and file the record.

risks.title: Logging gap on the sandbox
risks.statement: The experiments repository has no required review, so a change can ship without a trace in the ticket.
risks.treatmentPlan: Accept until the repository is archived. Review again next quarter.

risks.title: Training overdue
risks.statement: Several people are past the security-training date.
risks.treatmentPlan: Send the reminder and record completion.
